references.text: Nethanel, son of Zuar, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Issachar at the census, showing that the tribe had different leaders in different periods.
Nethanel, son of Zuar, brought offerings on behalf of the tribe of Issachar at the dedication of the tabernacle, illustrating the tribe's role in Israel's community.
Igal, son of Joseph, was the spy from the tribe of Issachar, showing that different representatives were chosen for various missions.
Palti is mentioned among the twelve leaders who were to distribute the land of Canaan among the tribes, one from each tribe.
Describes the inheritance of Issachar in the promised land, which Palti helped to distribute.
Tells of Issachar's birth as a son of Jacob and Leah, the origin of the tribe.
